name: CreateSubscriptionInstance

parameters.help_en: The region to which the change tracking instance belongs. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所属的地域，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Set this parameter to the region where the subscription object resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，与订阅对象所在地域保持一致，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
数据订阅的实例类型，取值为：MySQL、PolarDB、DRDS、Oracle。
默认取值为：MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据订阅的实例类型，取值为：MySQL、PolarDB、DRDS、Oracle。
默认取值为：MySQL
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method.

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go. This is the default value.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。

Postpaid：按量付费，默认付费类型。
Prepaid：预付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the subscription instance. Valid values:

Year: annual subscription.
Month: monthly subscription.

This parameter is valid and required only when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例的计费方式，取值：

Year：包年。
Month：包月。

当付费类型为Prepaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The purchase duration of the subscription instance.

If the billing method is set to Year (annual subscription), the valid values are 1 to 5.
If the billing method is set to Month (monthly subscription), the valid values are 1 to 60.

This parameter is valid and required only when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例购买时长。

当计费方式为Year（包年）时，取值范围为1~5。
当计费方式为Month（包月）时，取值范围为1~60。

当付费类型为Prepaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
